activeHandoffPrompt.reason: Official-source research did not identify a new artifact-free read-only source that can prove voucher, sequential, and insurance identifiers for the current non-duplicate target.

sourcesChecked.finding: The official overview establishes that ORCA APIs are WEB APIs for reference/update operations through glserver, but it does not itself define another read-only visit identifier proof endpoint.

medicalgetv2 remains an official read-only candidate source for perform date, department, sequential, insurance-combination, and invoice/voucher-like identifier families. This source is already implemented in the current identifier preflight, and the current target returned zero ready rows.

The official PDF confirms class 01 response fields include perform date, department, sequential, insurance-combination, and invoice number for outpatient history, and class 02 can be searched by invoice number. It does not change the current proof rule or supply a new target-ready row for the current Trial state.

sourcesChecked.endpointIdentity: medicaltemp read-only temporary medical data list
sourcesChecked.finding: medicaltemp exposes patient, department, physician, and insurance-combination fields for temporary data, but the checked official response list does not provide the voucher/invoice and sequential pair needed to tie the selected acceptance to the later order-send identity.

PushAPI patient_account notifications can include patient, perform date, insurance-combination, department, physician, and invoice number on registration/update/delete events. It is event notification, not an artifact-free current-state read-only lookup for the selected target, and it still lacks a separate sequential proof in the checked notification fields.

derivedNoLiveNextAction: Do not run diagnostic Fullflow for the current target. Keep the active RWO-08B blocker as Trial business/test-data state until a non-duplicate target has artifact-free read-only medicalgetv2 or visitptlstv2 voucher/sequential/insurance identifier proof, or a separately reviewed complete endpoint packet creates that prerequisite under the Trial-only scope.
